missions.guest_notice: Guests can view mission content. Completing missions and receiving internal points requires member login.
missions.completed_status: Completed. Internal points have been recorded.
missions.status.already_completed: This mission is already completed. Internal points will not be issued again.
missions.status.completed_points_added: Mission completed. Internal points have been added to the member account.
events.free_join_body: Free join does not use internal points. If the event requires sharing, use one of the social buttons first so the system can record the share action and verification.
events.login_body: Log in with a member account to join for free or use internal points for an event ticket.
events.tickets_intro: View free-join and internal-points ticket status. Tickets are only for platform events; they are not cash and cannot be withdrawn.
events.not_announced_or_not_selected: Not selected or not announced yet
events.tickets_empty_body: Go to the Event Center to join events for free or use internal points for event tickets.
events.status.free_join_existing: You have already completed free join registration.
events.status.free_join_completed: Free join completed. The share action has been recorded when required.
events.status.points_ticket_existing: You have already redeemed this event ticket.
events.status.points_ticket_completed: Internal points ticket redeemed. Ticket status has been updated.
events.error.free_join_closed: This event is not open for free join right now.
events.error.share_required: Use a social share button first so the system can record the share action.
events.error.participant_full: This event has reached its participant limit.
events.error.points_ticket_closed: This event is not open for internal-points tickets right now.
events.error.ticket_quota_full: Internal-points tickets for this event are full.
events.error.insufficient_internal_point: Not enough internal points to redeem this event ticket.
shop.external_note: After clicking through to the partner site, purchase, payment, delivery, and customer support follow the external platform rules.
redeem.rules_order_body: After a member submits a redemption, the system deducts internal points and creates a redemption order. Members must provide delivery information, and the Timeblock team will arrange fulfillment according to order status.
redeem.points_notice: Internal points are only used inside Timeblock. They have no cash value and cannot be withdrawn, resold, or redeemed for cash.
redeem.checkout_intro: After submission, the system deducts internal points and creates a redemption order. The Timeblock team will arrange delivery according to recipient information and stock status.
redeem.order_submitted_body: Internal points have been deducted. The Timeblock team will arrange shipment according to the delivery information.
redeem.delivery_note_placeholder: Optional delivery time, recipient reminder, or other notes
redeem.confirm_submit: Confirm redemption and deduct internal points
redeem.error.out_of_stock: This redemption item is currently out of stock.
redeem.error.delivery_required: Please complete recipient name, phone, and delivery address.
redeem.error.insufficient_internal_point: Not enough internal points to complete this redemption.
redeem.error.per_member_limit_reached: This item has reached the per-member redemption limit.
points.admin.error.member_not_found: The specified member email was not found.
points.admin.error.member_only: Only member accounts can have internal points adjusted.
missions.share.pending_note: Internal points are issued only after the submitted public share link is reviewed and approved.
missions.share.evidence_note: Read the content first, share it publicly on an allowed social platform, then submit the public post URL. Do not submit a profile or home-page URL.
missions.share.status.pending: Evidence submitted for admin review. No internal points have been issued yet.
missions.share.error.unsupported: This mission does not accept share evidence.
missions.share.error.open_first: Open and read the Timeblock content before submitting share evidence.
missions.share.error.read_longer: Please spend more time reading the content before submitting evidence.
missions.share.error.evidence_url: Submit a public post URL from an allowed social platform.
